correctness.rationale: For every primitive lattice normal \(z\), exact vertex supports yield \(D(z)=b(M-m)/2+|b(M+m)/2-a\cdot z|\). Every nonzero integer normal with \(M-m\ge2\) has \(D(z)\ge b\); nonempty subset indicators have \(D(z)<b\) since all weights are positive and their sum is below \(b\). Thus all minimizers have integer range one and are signed subset indicators. The positive-integer PARTITION encoding gives a polynomial-time equivalence, with subset certificate for membership in NP; the universal claim is analytical and 305 exact regression tests supplement it.

value.rationale: A complete geometry-of-numbers evaluation over moving origins reveals a discrete discrepancy spectrum and exact primitive-normal strata. The weak NP-completeness theorem locates a genuine variable-dimensional computational obstruction even for homothetic right simplexes, and equal-translation geometry has multiple noncentroid maxima in even dimensions; these are natural motivated structural facts beyond a numerical special case.
